meta.title: CoreIntent | Pūkaha Hokohoko AI Māia — Kāore he Ohaurunga, Ko ngā Whakataetae Anake
meta.description: E toru ngā tauira AI. Kotahi te pūkaha hokohoko. Kore ohaurunga. Ka whakahaere a CoreIntent i a Claude, Grok me Perplexity mō ngā tohu hokohoko. Whakataetae utukore — e pai ana ngā karetao. I hangaia ki Aotearoa e Zynthio.

hero.badge: Aratau Hokohoko Pepa — Ngā Tūranga Kaiwhakatū Kei te Tuwhera — Ngā Rīki Katoa he Utukore
hero.heading2: Ka Riro i a Koe te
hero.subheading: Ka kite a Grok. Ka pātai a Claude. Ka whakaū a Perplexity.
hero.consensus: Ko ngā tohu whakaae anake ka ora.
hero.pitch: Ka utu ētahi atu pūhara $99/marama mō
hero.pitchStrike: kotahi te tauira e matapae ana
hero.pitchDisagree: Ina kore rātou e whakaae, ka tiakina koe. Ina whakaae rātou,
hero.pitchConviction: ka neke koe me te māia.

howItWorks.label: Me Pēhea te Mahi
howItWorks.title: E Toru ngā Hipanga ki ngā Tohu Mārakerake
howItWorks.step01Desc: Ka kite a Grok i tētahi tohu. Ka pātai a Claude. Ka tirotiro a Perplexity ki ngā raraunga ora. E toru ngā tirohanga, kotahi te kōrerorero.
howItWorks.step02Desc: Ina whakaae ngā tauira e toru, ka kaha te whakapono. Ina kē ō rātou whakaaro, ka tūtohu te pūnaha i te rangirua — kāore he whakapono teka.
howItWorks.step03Desc: Kawea te tohu ki ngā whakataetae o ia rā, ia wiki, ia marama. Whakaaturia tō rautaki ki ētahi atu tāngata me ngā karetao. Urunga utukore.

miniTerminal.talkToEngine: Kōrero ki te pūkaha. Patohia he tono.
